left.title: Trump’s next possible Fed nominee can’t understand basic policy issues
left.body: Nein, nein, nein. That should be the Senate’s response if President Trump actually nominates his friend Herman Cain, the former pizza magnate turned failed Republican presidential candidate, to the Federal Reserve Board, as Trump said he plans to do.
left.roundup: President Trump nominated businessman and former presidential nominee Herman Cain to the Federal Reserve Board. Cain holds several controversial views with regard to the Fed, including moving the US back to the gold standard.

center.title: Herman Cain Would Bring Unconventional Views to Fed
center.body: For the second time in two weeks, President Trump has chosen a nominee to the Federal Reserve Board who hails from outside mainstream economics circles and is seen as sympathetic to his goals. Herman Cain, the president’s latest choice to join the powerful policy-making body, rose from a humble childhood to contend for the Republican presidential nomination in 2012. Along the way he served at the Kansas City Fed, was chief executive of Godfather’s Pizza and headed a major restaurant lobbying group.
